people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
translations.bsb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
translations.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
translations.asv: Now if Christ is preached that he hath been raised from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
